cells.name: Transfer bridge span
cells.description: A heavy deck on box girders over the melt, railings both sides; laid end to end east-west. Floor.

cells.name: Transfer bridge end
cells.description: The bridge's abutment on a cast footing at the west bank, deck to the east; mirrored for the east bank. Floor.

cells.name: Transfer bridge span, damaged
cells.description: A span with its north railing torn and the deck buckled and split over the melt. Floor.
